tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// rab gnas mdor bsdus dge legs rin po che'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon po la// btud nas snod bcud byin zab kyi// gzi byin 'bar byed rab gnas tshul// mdor bsdus gong ma'i gsung bzhin dgod// de la 'dir rab gnas mdor bsdus bya ba'i tshul ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten gang yin pa de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ gtor ma zlum po bzhi/ bgegs gtor/ gzhi bdag gtor ma ste drug bsham/ bum pa gnyis sam gcig spyi ltar bcas la/ mchod pa rnams oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ ces dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs kyis mthar/ dharmā ra ṇi ta dang rol mo byas te byin dbab/ de nas bdag bskyed tshe dpag med sogs gang la mos shing bsnyen pa song ba zhig gi sgom bzlas rdzogs par bya/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du bdag bskyed gang yin gyi lha gtso rkyang ngam/ 'khor bcas gang rung rang rang gi gzhung bzhin bskyed nas mchod bstod bya/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song ba bum nang gi lha la phog pas thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/

ces dang sngags ci nus bzlas la mchod bstod bya/ spyi ltar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig bzhu ba'i chu bdud rtsir gyur par bsams pa'am/ bla med yin na dam ye phye mi dgos pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum lha 'od du zhu ba'i chu bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ las bum la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa spros pas las bum gyi chu dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla'o// de nas sbyang ba ni/ mtheb kyu rten la bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rnams la rab tu gnas par byed pa la mi mthun par byed pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis shig ces dang*/ ting lo changs bu rten la bskor zhing*/ oṃ suṃ bha sogs gsum dang*/ 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rnams la rab tu gnas par byed pa la mi mthun par byed pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ changs bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo'i bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren gdul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/

pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngams stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs// khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das

bdag bskyed gang yin gyi mtshan sbyar/ 'di zhes bya ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis deng 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par rang rang gi gnas su song zhig gal te mi 'gro na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod la rten gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ ngag tu/ suṃ bha sogs dang*/ sarba bigh+nān u tsaṭ+ṭā ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces drag tu brjod cing drag rol bya'o// yang*/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra zhes sogs nas/ 'gas par 'gyur ro// suṃ bha sogs brjod pa de lta bu lan gnyis bya'o// khrus ni/ rten gyi gzugs brnyan me long la shar ba bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ spro na/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs kyi mthar/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā zhes brjod cing dar ram ras dkar pos sku phyi ba'i tshul bya/ de nas sku rten thor bu ba yin na/ las bum gyi chu 'thor zhing*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ sku rten rnams stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i khri/

pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan nam/ khro bo rnams la ram̐ las nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ rten gyi lha so so'i sa bon nam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las so so'i sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs ma 'chol bar bskyed/ rten ngos mi zin pa dang*/ mngon rtogs mi 'khyor na thams cad 'og gi mchod rten ltar rnam snang du bskyed kyang rung bas/ de ltar na lha khang logs bris can dang*/ sku rten dang*/ mchod rten rnams/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ lha khang dang*/ sku rten dang*/ mchod rten rnams stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i khri/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa bskyed/ pusti sogs gsung rten rnams sbyang*/ gsung rten rnams stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i khri/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ āḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rdor dril phyag mtshan sogs thugs rten rnams sbyang*/ thugs rten rnams stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i khri/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dkyil thang yin na sbyang*/ dkyil 'khor stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i lha gnas rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad sogs gong ltar bskyed/

'khor lo dang 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa sbyang*/ 'khor lo rnams stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis bris pa'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur ces dang*/ rta babs sogs sbyang*/ rta babs dang*/ rdo rings dang*/ rdzing bu la sogs pa rnams stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las lha rdzas las grub pa'i dngos po de dang de'i rnam pa can du gyur ces pas bskyed do// de nas lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bskyed pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos bcas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa// rgyal ba ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mchod nas/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni// dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na// lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar// de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu// 'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*// sems can kun gyi don slad du// bdag gis 'byor pa nyid kyis ni// ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa rnams// me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// rjes su brtse bas dgongs su gsol// kun gyis 'di la byin brlab cing*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ zhes lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmang du brjod/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang dang rten gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/

dbang bskur gyi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas sku thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang rang dang 'dra ba'i rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan par bsam/ mchod pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ dharma ra ṇi ta sogs brjod/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du// sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas// thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa// thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir// sems can khams nas bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*// chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa// 'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// sems can bkren pa chos kyi phongs gyur pa// ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams// 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa// ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la// thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bzhag nas// zhi ba rin chen gling du skyel mdzad pa// kun gyi ded dpon khyed la kun nas 'dud// sems can las kyi chu bor gru nub rnams// dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa// gsung gi mnga' bdag khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// gser gyi thur ma'am rdo rjes spyan dbye ba'i tshul bya zhing*/

kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam mo// slar yang oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs gong ltar dang*/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bstod/ sngags kyis mnga' dbul ba'i phyir/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas rten gyi thugs kar thim/ de las kyang 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs sngags kyi rnam pas rten de rnams la zhugs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang nus pa mnyam par bsam zhing*/ me tog lag tu bzung nas rten gtso gang yin pa'i sngags ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba dang*/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa swā hā/ zhes gang 'grub brjod pas/ nas 'bru re re nas ye dharmā'i yig 'bru gser 'od 'bar ba re rer gyur par bsams la/ ye dharmā dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbhū khaṃ badz+rī bha ba dṛḍha tiṣ+ṭha bhū khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rten de la me tog gtor bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang me tog 'thor zhing*/ rten de khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' phul bar bsam mo// de nas mchod pas mnga' dbul ba'i phyir/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bcas rgya cher bshams pa rnams/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'am/ 'jig rten khams ni sogs dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la sogs kyis rgyal srid bdun dang*/

kha dog dbyibs legs sogs kyis 'dod yod lnga dbul ba'am/ bsdu na/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor la dbang bsgyur yang*// 'gro ba'i don slad 'dod yon rnam lnga yis// mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis// bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro bas mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ sap+ta ma hā rat+na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dbul/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'am so bdun ma sogs lag len ltar dgod cing dbul ba'am/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs nas spyod par shog /oṃ bud+dha k+ṣe tra bi shud+dhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā zhes brjod do// bstod pa gong ltar 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs brjod/ de nas me tog thogs te lha sngags yig brgya sngon du 'gro bas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis dkon mchog gi rten 'di rnams la rab tu gnas pa bgyis pa'i mthus/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad 'khor ba ji srid du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs nas/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa dang*/ bye brag tu'ang rten 'di rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du/ ye shes pa thams cad rten 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs nas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi skyabs gnas dam pa mdzad cing*/ yon gyi bdag pos gtso byas pa thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/

ye dharmā bcas lan gsum brjod cing me tog gi char dbab/ srung 'khor la ni/ bye brag tu'ang rten 'brel srung ba'i 'khor lo 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas 'chang ba po la bar du gcod pa thams cad las bsrung du gsol zhes bsgyur/ slob dpon gyis rten gyi spyi bor rdo rje gtugs par mos nas/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ sku rten la rnam snang 'od du zhu ba las rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ lha khang dang*/ mchod rten yin na/ rnam snang 'od du zhu ba las lha khang ngam/ mchod rten mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam pa can gyi nang du rnam snang la sogs pa'i rigs lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang sems nyan rang chos srung nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ gsung rten la 'od dpag med zhu ba las lung dang rtogs pa'i chos dkon mchog gi rang bzhin glegs bam gyi gzugs su gyur/ thugs rten la mi bskyod pa zhu ba las mtshan so so'i rnam par gyur/ ces so sor sbyar ba'am/ bsdu na/ bskyed pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta bar gyur/ ces brjod kyang rung*/ dkyil thang ni sku rten gyi zhar la dmigs pa tsam gyis 'thus shing*/ 'khor lo la sogs thor bu gzhan rnams ni rnam pa de dag las bsgyur mi dgos so// slar yang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ lha sku rnams la so so'i sgos bstod shes na sh+lo ka re res bstod/ mi shes na thun mong du/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// sogs dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sogs/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan sogs dang*/ dag pa 'dod chags bral sogs dang*/ grol nas grol sogs dang*/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i sogs dang*/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs kyis bstod cing*/ spyi tsam du mnyam nyid mi g.yo ma'am/

'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs kyis 'thus/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlabs nas/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis phul/ gong ltar mchod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma gnyis pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā ka la sa pa ri wā ra na mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ rdzu 'phrul stobs dang sogs kyis bstod/ chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog ces phrin las bcol/ rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pas rten 'di rnams ji srid gnas kyi bar du srung mar mdzod cig ces bka' bsgo bar bya'o// de nas gtor ma gsum ni cha gsum gyi cho gas btang la/ drug pa ni gzhi bdag la dbul te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs mgron dgug oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o// de nas bkra shis kyis mnga' dbul ba'i phyir tshogs pa thams cad kyis me tog bzung la/ rten 'brel snying po gang mang brjod pa'i mthar/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// zhes sogs mdo rgyud las 'byung ba'i bkra shis gang mang brjod/

mthar bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba yon gyi bdag po dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig 'jig rten thams cad bkra shis par gyur cig ces me tog dang rol mo'i sgra sbyar bar bya'o// 'thor nas dgos na gnas so sor bgegs bskrad dang*/ khrus bsdus pa/ brtan bzhugs tsam dang bkra shis bya/ rang gnas su 'khor ba dang*/ slar yang brtan bzhugs dang*/ bkra shis gang rigs brjod par bya'o// de nas yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i// sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du// ji ltar gsungs pa ji bzhin du// de dag don ni ngas byas te// de rnams don ni grub zin gyis// ci bde bar ni mchod par byos// khyod kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa de legs par tshar bar byas kyi/ khyod kyi rten 'di rnams la zhag bdun du mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig de nas kyang ci 'byor pa'i mchod pas rgyun mi chad par mchod par gyis shig ces bsgo/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pas bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis cho ga'i lhag chad kha bskang*/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ chos skyong gi rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol bya'o// slar yang sbyin bdag bsang sbyang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams skad cig gis tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku can re rer gyur ces pa lta bu bdag bskyed gang yin du bskyed/ bgegs bskrad mdor bsdus dang*/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te// rnam dag chos la thog med longs spyod pa'i// bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman// sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te// nyon mongs zung rngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig

/zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs nas// yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi gyur cig /dūrbas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub nas// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /bilba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun// byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang don kun grub gyur cig /dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te// chos rnams ma nor yongs su bstan pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te// chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus nas kyang*// chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste// mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog /ces sbyin bdag la 'grims nas rten gyi drung du 'jog che ba'i che mchog sogs bkra shis brjod nas sbyin bdag gyes/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum byin rlabs kyis bsrung bas mtshon rang rang gi gzhung ltar dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs bsngo smon spyi dang*/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs gdab/ kha na ma tho ba rnams rten de nyid la bzod par gsol zhing yi ge brgya pa ci nus su brjod nas/ las kyi rjes bsdu la chos bzhin du gnas par bya'o// zhes pa'ang sgrub thabs rin po che kun las btus pa'i zhal skong du blo gter dbang pos 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang legs grub kyi gsung las snying po btus te bkod pa'i dge bas snod bcud kyi rgud pa mtha' dag zhi zhing*/

srid zhi'i legs tshogs thams cad yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
